children: US hotel REIT's Q3 revenue rose 7.4%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted FFO per diluted share rose 25.9% year-over-year
Company raised full-year 2026 outlook after Q3 outperformance
Company raises full-year 2026 guidance following Q3 outperformance and positive October trends
Company sees FY 2026 comparable RevPAR growth of 5.75% to 6.25%
RLJ Lodging Trust expects FY 2026 comparable hotel EBITDA of $377 mln to $383 mln
BUSINESS, LEISURE & GROUP DEMAND - Co said increased business travel and continued strength in leisure and group bookings, especially in urban markets, drove RevPAR growth
RENOVATIONS & CONVERSIONS - Co said hotel conversions and renovations contributed to growth in non-room revenues
COST CONTROL - Co said disciplined expense management supported margin expansion and Hotel EBITDA growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 7 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the specialized reits peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for RLJ Lodging Trust is $12.00, about 4.7% below its November 3 closing price of $12.59
The stock recently traded at 137 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 4,136 three months ago
